name: Quest 3D Dicom
summary:
Explore compatible local DICOM series and OBJ/FBX models in mixed reality on Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S. For educational and scientific visualization only.

View DICOM-derived 3D surfaces and source-grid slices. Adjust position, rotation, scale, transparency, surface appearance, slice brightness and contrast with spatial controls. Arrange imported models using virtual placement and local transforms.

Optional camera and spatial-data workflows support marker recognition, native QR and scanned-room placement.
